title: Quick Grassy Spanish Beef Burger
description: A one-pot Spanish dish featuring sesame seed burger buns and beurre-monte, this recipe is diabetic-friendly and offers a unique blend of flavors and textures. The dish is characterized by its grassy and silky elements.
instructions: Preheat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In the skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter and add the ground beef, breaking it apart with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the pimenton smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to the ground beef and stir to combine.
Once the ground beef is browned, add the grassy olive oil and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in the shredded manchego cheese until melted and well combined.
Split the sesame seed buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the burgers by spooning the beef mixture onto the toasted buns.
Top each burger with a dollop of beurre-monte and a sprinkle of chopped fresh parsley.
